boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named stops on campus-adjacent Dinkytown, Riverside Avenue, Cedar Avenue, and South Fourth Street corridors, each with a directly sourced reason to go.

cards.title: A breakfast stop on 14th
cards.subtitle: 14th Avenue SE corridor, between 4th and 5th streets
cards.notes: Use the official directions to find this Dinkytown breakfast counter on 14th Avenue SE; check its current closing-day notice before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A specifically located breakfast counter in historic Dinkytown.
cards.evidence_claim: Al's Breakfast says it is in historic Dinkytown on 14th Avenue SE between 4th and 5th streets and lists its Minneapolis address as 413 14th Ave SE.
cards.source_title: How to Find Us | Al's Breakfast
cards.access_notes: The official page lists service hours and several annual closure dates; verify the page before visiting.

cards.title: Browse upstairs books
cards.subtitle: 4th Street SE corridor, Dinkytown
cards.notes: Go upstairs at 1316 4th Street SE and allow time to browse; the shop’s contact page posts distinct weekday and weekend hours.
cards.short_summary: An upstairs bookshop with published hours on the 4th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Book House in Dinkytown lists its upstairs address as 1316 4th St SE, Minneapolis, along with weekday and weekend hours.
cards.source_title: Contact | The Book House in Dinkytown
cards.access_notes: The shop is upstairs; consult its contact page for the current day’s hours.

cards.title: Use a public library branch
cards.subtitle: 4th Street SE corridor, Dinkytown
cards.notes: Bring a library card if you plan to borrow materials, or use this 4th Street SE branch as a public indoor stop during its listed hours.
cards.short_summary: A county library branch directly on the Dinkytown 4th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Hennepin County lists Arvonne Fraser Library at 1222 4th Street Southeast in Minneapolis and publishes its weekly hours.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by day and the branch is listed as closed Sundays; confirm the county schedule before visiting.

cards.title: A Mediterranean menu stop
cards.subtitle: 14th Avenue SE corridor, Dinkytown
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s menu before you go and use its Dinkytown location as a 14th Avenue SE food stop near the 4th Street junction.
cards.short_summary: A Dinkytown restaurant whose official page identifies Mediterranean and Middle Eastern dishes.
cards.evidence_claim: Wally's official site identifies the Dinkytown restaurant as being on 4th Street SE in Minneapolis and lists falafel, hummus, shawirma, kabobs, and teas.
cards.source_title: About Us | Wally's Falafel and Hummus
cards.access_notes: Menu items and availability can change; review the restaurant’s current information before ordering.

cards.title: A 4th Street food address
cards.subtitle: 4th Street SE corridor, Dinkytown
cards.notes: Use the Dinkytown association’s address listing to locate this Suite A food stop, then check the business directly for current ordering details.
cards.short_summary: A named restaurant listing at 1421 4th Street SE.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dinkytown Business Association directory lists Boba X Ramen at 1421 4th Street SE, Suite A.
cards.access_notes: The association directory supplies the location; confirm current service details with the business before a visit.

cards.title: Explore an Ethiopian menu
cards.subtitle: Riverside Avenue corridor, Cedar-Riverside
cards.notes: Find Dilla’s at 1813 Riverside Avenue and review its menu first if you are planning a meal with a group or dietary preferences.
cards.short_summary: A Riverside Avenue Ethiopian restaurant with a directly published address.
cards.evidence_claim: Dilla's Ethiopian Restaurant publishes its address as 1813 Riverside Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55454.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s official contact page provides the address and online ordering link; verify service details before visiting.

cards.title: A Riverside Avenue café
cards.subtitle: Riverside Avenue corridor, Cedar-Riverside
cards.notes: Use the City’s license record to confirm the Riverside Avenue address, then check the café directly for current food service and access details.
cards.short_summary: A named café at 1821 Riverside Avenue in Cedar-Riverside.
cards.evidence_claim: A City of Minneapolis license record identifies Hard Times Cafe at 1821 Riverside Ave in the Cedar-Riverside neighborhood.
cards.source_title: Hard Times Cafe Street Cafe License Record | City of Minneapolis
cards.access_notes: This source verifies the location; contact the café directly for current hours and offerings.

cards.title: See the global-music calendar
cards.subtitle: Cedar Avenue South corridor, Cedar-Riverside
cards.notes: Review the current event calendar and the specific event’s admission details before going to this nonprofit venue at 416 Cedar Avenue South.
cards.short_summary: A Cedar-Riverside nonprofit presenting global music and dance.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cedar states that its mission includes presenting global music and dance and lists its location as 416 Cedar Avenue South in Minneapolis.
cards.access_notes: Admission, age guidance, and schedules are event-specific; check the listing before attending.

cards.title: A theatre-in-the-round performance
cards.subtitle: Cedar Avenue South corridor, West Bank Theatre District
cards.notes: Check the production page for content and ticket details, then plan for the theatre at 245 Cedar Avenue on the West Bank corridor.
cards.short_summary: A community theatre located between the University’s main campus and downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Theatre in the Round says it is in the West Bank Theatre District, between the University of Minnesota main campus and downtown, at 245 Cedar Avenue.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Theatre in the Round Players
cards.access_notes: Show times, ticketing, and content notices are production-specific; review the theatre’s current visit page before attending.

cards.title: The historic Firehouse venue
cards.subtitle: South Fourth Street corridor, West Bank
cards.notes: Look for public performances or community programming at the Firehouse and confirm the current event’s access details before traveling to South Fourth Street.
cards.short_summary: A theatre organization based at 1501 South Fourth Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Mixed Blood identifies its location as 1501 South Fourth Street, Minneapolis, and says it uses theatre to advance equity and build community.
cards.access_notes: Confirm whether a public event is scheduled and review that event’s admission and age information before visiting.
